  def create_dependency_tree(items):
      # type: (List[ExecutionItem]) -> List[List[ExecutionItem]]
      if not items:
          return []
      
      # Build a map of item names to items for quick lookup
      items_by_name = {item.name: item for item in items}
      all_names = set(items_by_name.keys())

      # The result stages - each stage contains items that can run in parallel
      stages = []
      # Set of names already placed in previous stages
      placed_in_previous_stages = set()

      # Process items in their original order to preserve order as much as possible
      # Items with no dependencies or whose dependencies are in previous stages go into the current stage.
      # Others are deferred to the next pass.
      remaining = list(items)
      changed = True
      while changed:
          changed = False
          current_stage = []
          next_remaining = []
          for item in remaining:
              if not item.depends:
                  current_stage.append(item)
                  changed = True
              else:
                  # Check if all dependencies are already placed in previous stages
                  if all(dep in placed_in_previous_stages for dep in item.depends):
                      current_stage.append(item)
                      changed = True
                  else:
                      next_remaining.append(item)
          if current_stage:
              for item in current_stage:
                  placed_in_previous_stages.add(item.name)
              stages.append(current_stage)
          remaining = next_remaining
